name: Shopify App Store Reviews
title: Shopify App Store Reviews Scraper
uses: Shopify app developers tracking reviews, ratings and developer replies for their app and rivals
Founders sizing a Shopify app category before they build
Agencies and investors comparing ratings, review counts and pricing plans across a category
AI agents summarizing merchant complaints for a Shopify app

inputs.name: appHandles
inputs.title: App handles or App Store URLs
inputs.description: One app per line: a handle (klaviyo-email-marketing) or an apps.shopify.com URL. Leave empty if you only want the category listing mode.

inputs.name: maxReviewsPerApp
inputs.title: Max reviews per app
inputs.description: How many reviews to return per app. 0 means all public reviews (paginated). Default 200.

inputs.name: starFilter
inputs.title: Star filter (ratings[])
inputs.description: Optional list of star ratings, passed to the Store as ratings[] (e.g. [1, 2] for one- and two-star reviews). Leave empty for all ratings.

inputs.name: categoryUrl
inputs.title: Category URL or slug (bonus mode)
inputs.description: Optional. A Shopify App Store category URL or slug (e.g. marketing-and-conversion-social-trust-product-reviews or the full /categories/.../all URL). Returns one listing row per app with name, rating and review count. Parent categories crawl subcategory /all pages.

inputs.name: maxAppsInCategory
inputs.title: Max apps in category mode
inputs.description: Maximum app listing rows to return when Category URL is set.

inputs.name: phrases
inputs.title: Phrases to count in low-star reviews
inputs.description: Optional phrases. Adds one free keywordSummary row per app with case-insensitive counts over reviews at or below Low-star max. Counts cover only the reviews returned in this run, not estimates.

inputs.name: lowStarMax
inputs.title: Low-star max (for phrase counts)
inputs.description: Phrase counts use reviews with this rating or lower. Ignored if Phrases is empty.

inputs.name: includeSummary
inputs.title: Add a free summary row per app
inputs.description: Adds one uncharged row with the listing rating, review count, launch date, pricing plans, and the rating distribution of the reviews returned.

description: Scrape Shopify App Store reviews by handle, with the ratings[] filter, store name, country, time using the app and developer replies. Also returns listing rating, review count, pricing plans and launch date, plus a category listing mode. No login or proxy. $0.00002/review.
